text: BTA's "Archives and Reference" Directorate received the award of the Association of Bulgarian Airlines for contribution to the preservation of historical memory (28.04.2026 15:16)

The "Archives and Reference" Directorate of the Bulgarian News Agency (BTA) received an award from the Association of Bulgarian Airlines for its contribution to the preservation of the historical memory of "Bulgarian Civil Aviation" (BGA). The distinction was presented at an official ceremony at the Vega Hotel in Sofia, and the award was accepted by Desislava Sevova, Director of the "Archives and Reference" Directorate at BTA.

She expressed gratitude for the distinction and defined it as a high assessment not only of her personal work, but also of the efforts and professionalism of the team she leads. In her words, the award is perceived as recognition of the importance of archival activity and as respect for the generations of journalists and employees who worked throughout the 128-year history of BTA and left their contribution.
Sevova emphasized that today's real news creates tomorrow's history, and the mission of the archive is to preserve it.
Anton Mitov from the "Archive Fund" Directorate of the Bulgarian National Radio (BNR) was also awarded the same distinction for his contribution to the preservation of historical memory.

ABA also awarded a prize - the "Flight" statuette for the preservation of historical heritage and contribution to the development of the BGA, to the Institute of Air Transport, known as the "Forge of Aviation Personnel," which marks its 55th anniversary this year. The distinction was accepted by the manager of the institute and honorary chairman of the ABA, Svetoslav Stanulov. The award was presented to him by the chairman of the Bulgarian Industrial Capital Association, Rumen Radev.

The "Flight" statuette for overall contribution and accurate coverage of aviation topics was awarded to the "24 Chasa" newspaper, which is celebrating 35 years since its founding. The distinction was presented by the chairman of the ABA, Yovko Yotsev, and the award was accepted by Ivan Mihalev, the publication's commercial director.

Zhivko Konstantinov received an award for the creation of the website "Travel Radar" and for a series of films on aviation themes. The distinction was presented to him by the Deputy Minister of Transport and Communications, Dimitar Nedyalkov. Nedyalkov noted that a difficult year lies ahead for Bulgarian aviation, but emphasized that 2025 was extremely successful and expressed hope that the same good results would be achieved in 2026.
Dragomir Draganov from the Bulgarian National Television (BNT) was also honored with an award for overall contribution and preservation of historical memory.
For the accurate coverage of aviation topics, awards were also received by Zapryan Zapryanov from Nova TV, Stancho Stanchev from bTV, as well as the morning show of "Euronews Bulgaria."

A distinction for contribution to presenting the link between tourism and aviation was awarded to the website Bgtourism.bg, which, in addition to the ABA award, also received a statuette from Electra Airways.
Miroslav Ivanov, editor-in-chief of the TravelNews website, was also honored with an award for accurate coverage of aviation topics.
